name: Dafny
typeSystem: Static, strong type system (classes, algebraic datatypes, generics) extended with specifications: preconditions, postconditions, loop invariants, and termination measures that the compiler statically verifies rather than checks at run time.
runtime: Dafny code is first verified against an SMT solver at compile time; once verified, it is compiled or transpiled to a mainstream target language for actual execution.

runtimes.name: Transpile to C# / Java / JavaScript / Go / Python
runtimes.role: After verification, Dafny compiles down to a mainstream language's runtime for execution.

compilers.name: dafny verify
compilers.role: Generates verification conditions from specifications and discharges them via the Z3 SMT solver.

compilers.name: dafny build
compilers.role: Compiles verified Dafny source to C#, Java, JavaScript, Go, or Python.

concurrencyModel: N/A in the verified core language; compiled output inherits whatever concurrency model its target language provides.

codeExample.caption: A verified factorial: the postcondition is proved, not just tested
